messages.content: idk what to do about this debt hanging over me

What is the feeling-tone of the mind when it thinks about this debt? Is there a sense of restlessness, worry, or aversion? 

As Richard Ze noted, "It's easier if you let those perceptions arise and pass away and also to have beliefs challenged." — https://www.dharmaoverground.org/discussion/-/message_boards/message/4651886
